bottleneck_avoidance: Hermes does not wait on Codex except when fresh space reference is necessary.
Codex does not block Hermes execution unless Hermes explicitly requested retrieval.
Maturation is asynchronous/HOLD: Codex can inspect reentry after Hermes execution.
Gemini is not in Hermes path; only Codex-side when Codex detects unresolved layer ambiguity.
Large raw files are indexed, not first-pass default.
conflict_resolution: If both actors produce conflicting next_safe_lane, keep both in shared comparison file; Hermes may merge but not erase Codex proposal.
If Codex says apply but Hermes has no user approval, Hermes records HOLD_STOP_NO_APPROVAL.
If Hermes trace lacks space_reference_delta, Codex returns NEEDS_HERMES_REENTRY_REPAIR rather than guessing.

steps.action: Create run manifest and hermes_exec namespace. Preserve original and decide whether fresh space reference is needed.
If needed, write shared_handoff/01_SPACE_REFERENCE_REQUEST.json for Codex. Otherwise do local deterministic space setup.
Read request + compact indexes only. Write codex_space/10_CODEX_RETRIEVAL_RETURN.json. Do not edit Hermes files.
Read Codex return, merge original+space+model, execute/withhold, write hermes_exec/20 trace and shared_handoff/21 reentry index.
Read reentry index and Hermes trace. Decide HOLD-only maturation. If Gemini needed, invoke only Codex-side script-chain and record it. Write codex_space/30 proposal.
Read Codex proposal and record hermes_exec/40 receipt. No authority apply unless separate approval.
Use shared_handoff/99 latest pointers for cross-inspection; never rewrite historical artifacts.
